text_block_list.text:
After her fierce battle at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup,
Fusaichi Pandora instantly became
the Umamusume of the hour.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"A legendary race that hasn't faded even after a month!
Fusaichi Pandora, who carved deep hoofprints into Umamusume history, but—"

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: Today, we're diving into her private life! So... we hear there's an event coming up that you're really looking forward to?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Right! So, about Christmas...
I was thinking of spending it with you, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I've already picked the spot♡
I wanna have dinner there, give them a present, and just spend time together doing classic date stuff♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"So that's the plan~,
make sure you keep your schedule open, Trainer♡"

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu! Trainer-san, you look terribly surprised
on the other side of the camera, but—

This is completely news to me... but since it seems
to be a done deal in her mind, I hurry to clear my schedule.
Since the place is decided... that must mean she made a restaurant reservation or something.

I prepared a neat jacket just in case, bought a present, and then... Christmas Day arrived.
Heading to the designated meeting spot—
A large-scale party was being held on board the ship.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha♡ Good job, good job!
You're looking totally on point, love it♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's up?
You're totally spacing out.
choice_data_list: I never imagined it would be such a massive party...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Sorry, sorry, did I not tell you?
My dad's hosting a Christmas party on a whim—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Usually it's just family, but sometimes we get a big jumble of friends and acquaintances together! That's what we're doing this year!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So come on, just chill out☆
No need for formal greetings or anything—
winging it is totally fine, so let's just take it easy♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, so good!! What was this called again,
Beef Fillet Rossini?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
The canard à l'orange from before was delicious,
but this is the ab-so-lute best too♡

Before having time to quail at dish names that hardly
sounded like something served at an individual's private party—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Mmm, no matter how many times I listen, it's so cool♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
A party really needs a live band, doesn't it?
I'd love to try playing the saxophone or something too.

"Fusaichi Pandora comes from a wealthy family."
Today served as a powerful reminder of that fact.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, a present?
Yay, thank you~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, this is my favorite brand!
And it's a lip primer?! Aah, this is the best!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've got something for you too.
A real special one!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I gave one to Papa and Mama before, and they cried tears of joy, so I'm super confident in it♡ Here you go!

...Did what I gave her truly balance out?
Nervously, I opened the envelope—

Inside was a handwritten card that said,
"Shoulder Massage Ticket."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: What's up? Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Did I just screw up?!
No way!! Touch the shoulder and I'm out?!"
choice_data_list: No, no, that's not what I meant!

text_block_list.text:
Not that it was a bad thing by any means,
but looking back on the day,
I was surprised by such a wonderfully modest gift.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Is that how it is!? No... wait,
seriously, this really was my absolute masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: B-But, but—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...I'm seriously grateful to you, you know.
Just as much as I am to my mom and dad.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
About me... well.
You've always believed in me all this time, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Even when I felt like it was totally impossible,
you kept calling me a 'genius,' didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Even when I was wavering, she never wavered one bit.
She believed in me even more than I believed in myself.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I think I was finally able
to believe in the end.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...'The Queen Elizabeth II Cup.'
There were Pandora chants, weren't there?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'd already given up on a lot of things, but...
it kinda reminded me just a little of that dream, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...I was happy.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Because you kept believing in me,
I was able to believe in myself too.
That's the view it brought us to.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So... thank you♡
For always believing in me!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So, like...
—Wait, what were we talking about?
choice_data_list: Um... why did you choose shoulder massage coupons—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah, exactly! That's why...
it shows just how much feeling went into it!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: It's not like I'm slacking off, you know--?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. That was terrifying.
Silence is seriously freakish, it stressed me out so bad.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...I panicked way too hard and now I'm exhausted.
Hey, could you, like, massage my shoulders?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! We can include
a "Coupon to Massage My Shoulders" with it♡
While wondering whether there was any benefit in this for us... it's true I overreacted a bit.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh, seriously!?
Yay, thank youuu~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, that loosens me right up!
You're pretty good at this, Trainer.

I ended up massaging her barely stiff shoulders for about ten minutes...
and that was how we spent the rest of Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...*phew*, that was a close one.
I was seriously confident, too.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Papa and Mama practically bawled when I gave it to them. And then when I gave them shoulder rubs, the waterworks really started.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No, like, I'm seriously good at shoulder rubs,
y'know! I totally know all the pressure points!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, want me to do it right now?
Alrighty, I'll take that "Shoulder Massage Coupon."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Take a seat, take a seat~
Alright, here we gooo.
(Tap-tap-tap-tap...)

My shoulders are worked on with a crisp rhythm
and just the right amount of pressure, melting
away the tension.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: That customer really has particular tastes.
Perhaps she'd been tense from the unfamiliar party, but her stiff shoulders gradually began to relax—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well? Pretty good, right!
I really can do anything, after all♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, Trainer put way more thought into it than I expected.
It's hilarious. So hilarious that—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'll make this offer unlimited for you♡
Be sure to ask again, okay~?

—It turned out to be a Christmas where
one could truly feel Fusaichi Pandora's deftly
clumsy brand of kindness.
